news.title: DeKalb man accused of killing ex-girlfriend despite no-contact order
news.summary: A DeKalb County grand jury indicted a 57-year-old man on Tuesday on charges including malice murder and felony murder in connection with the death of his ex-girlfriend.

news.title: Man accused of chasing other driver, shooting at vehicle on busy metro Atlanta road
news.summary: A metro Atlanta man accused of shooting at another car while chasing it in traffic faces multiple charges and remains in jail.

news.title: Decatur man indicted in fatal domestic violence beating
news.summary: A 57-year-old Decatur man faces multiple murder charges after grand jurors indicted him in the fatal stabbing and beating of his ex-girlfriend inside her apartment.

news.title: Canton high school graduate, Marine dies in accidental shooting
news.summary: A 21-year-old Marine and a metro Atlanta high school graduate has died after what police say was an accidental shooting.

news.title: Clark Atlanta University mourns student killed in Hank Aaron Drive crash
news.summary: A 21-year-old Clark Atlanta University student died following a late-night crash at Hank Aaron Drive and Glen Street.

news.title: Decatur attorney disbarred after pleading guilty to RICO charge
news.summary: The Supreme Court of Georgia disbarred a Decatur lawyer on Oct. 14 after he pleaded guilty to stealing data from the DeKalb County Police Department to recruit personal injury clients.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man arrested in connection with shooting of former Ga. Tech, 49ers player Keion White
news.summary: White was shot in the ankle while hosting a private party at a nightclub in San Francisco following the Super Bowl on February 9, 2026, police said.

news.title: Three Atlanta residents face charges in $74 million tax fraud scheme
news.summary: Three Mexican nationals in Atlanta face federal charges of running a tax fraud scheme that stole over $74 million from the U.S. Treasury.

news.title: 7th arrest made in Carolyn Crayton Park mass shooting which left 12 hurt
news.summary: 19-year-old Aramis Tucker was arrested and charged in the shooting, which broke out at a teenager's after-hours birthday celebration at the park's skatepark.

news.title: Man accused of 2023 deadly shooting of Atlanta nightclub owner in custody at Fulton County Jail after years on the run
news.summary: Jonathan Soto was arrested in Jacksonville, Florida in September 2026 and extradited to Fulton County in October 2026. He's accused of killing Michael Gidewon.

news.title: Clark Atlanta student killed in crash; Man accused of speeding through intersection facing charges
news.summary: Warrants state that the man was traveling at 94 mph in a 35 mph zone.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man cuts ankle monitor, tracks ex-girlfriend to Philadelphia before arrest
news.summary: N’Tyrance Davis, out on bond in two DeKalb domestic violence cases, allegedly removed his ankle monitor to pursue his ex-girlfriend.

news.title: Duluth woman arrested for allegedly stealing over $60K from elderly woman in scam
news.summary: According to deputies, the victim was convinced that the people she was handing over money to were federal authorities from the FDIC.
